title: 5.14 At the Table
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals, ask prices and order politely at a café or market.
goal: Name things on the table and say Ein Glas Wasser. Eine Tasse Tee. (no word for of).
grammar_function: Ein Glas / Eine Tasse / Eine Flasche / Ein Teller + food or drink.
